label: Prepaid home internet for foreign residents: available terms
appliesTo: Foreign residents in Korea whose stay is shorter or less certain than a standard contract term
why: The concrete alternative to signing thirty-six months you may not serve, and it is recent enough that most guidance does not mention it exists. Worth watching rather than stating once: a product aimed at a specific population, launched into a market built around long contracts, is exactly the kind of offering whose terms, price and availability move.

history.source: LG U+ — prepaid internet for foreign nationals
history.note: Sold to foreign nationals with no age restriction, on a passport, with no contract term, no early termination charge and no separate installation fee. The monthly cost is higher than a discounted long contract; the comparison is against the total cost of a term you might not complete, not against the headline monthly figure.
